<thought>To find a suitable one‑step retrosynthetic transformation, I will look for a template that converts two aldehyde groups into an alkene (the McMurry coupling). This corresponds to breaking aldehyde functional groups and forming an alkene. I will search the template catalog for such a transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehyde"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
